'''Lando's''' was an establishment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The name was printed on a large, green neon sign, in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters.
